scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Welcome to Cool Event Corp.
Our staff is always working
to surpass your expactations
for quality service. So how
may I assist you today?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
欢迎光临酷活动公司。
我们始终致力于提供超越您期待的优质服务。
今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using the
Cool Event Corp. service~
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您的复活点已保存于{0}。
感谢您使用酷活动公司的服务~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，初心者的基本技能需要达到6级，才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough Zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is 40 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法使用仓库服务。
使用仓库需要40 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Let me open your personal
storage for you right away.
Thanks for supporting Cool
Event Corp. by using our
services. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
马上为您打开个人仓库。
感谢您使用我们的服务，支持酷活动公司。
祝您今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法使用瞬间移动服务。
传送到{0}的费用是{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人系职业开放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, White Smiths,
Alchemists and Creators.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人、铁匠、神工匠、炼金术士和创造者开放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You can only rent a cart after
learning the Pushcart Skill.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
必须先学会手推车使用技能，才能租用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您已经有一辆手推车了。
很抱歉，每位顾客一次只能租用一辆。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 Zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
手推车租赁费是800 Zeny。
您要租用手推车吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
Zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法支付800 Zeny的手推车租赁费。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Cool Event Corp. is always
striving to provide the best
services for our customers.
Help us become the best by
providing us with your opinions
and honest feedback. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
酷活动公司始终致力于为顾客提供最优质的服务。
欢迎提出意见，如实反馈，帮助我们做得更好。
谢谢。
